verdict.rationale: Vercel documents provisioning a Postgres database through its Marketplace (Neon, Prisma Postgres, Supabase, AWS Aurora Postgres), with credentials and environment variables injected into the project. Its own Vercel Postgres product is discontinued, so the database comes from third-party providers. Nothing in the evidence documents point-in-time recovery, read replicas, or high availability. missing for 10: point-in-time recovery, read replicas, high availability/failover guarantees, a first-party managed Postgres offering, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can provision a fully-managed Postgres database with point-in-time recovery, replicas, and high availability

citations.quote: Provision and configure a Postgres database with minimal setup. Have credentials and environment variables injected into your Vercel project.
Neon is serverless Postgres built for the cloud, with autoscaling and instant branching.
